title: Top-notch, go for it with your eyes closed 😉
text:
Sandrine knew how to welcome us perfectly and explain everything to us in French, Kai was an attentive skipper and is a very pleasant professional to talk to. 
The swimming breaks were greatly appreciated. 
In short, a great experience that appealed to both young and old. 
If we have the opportunity to come back to the area, we will probably do the trip again. 
Thanks again to you for this lovely outing.
author: K9670JZflorencep

title: Unforgettable experience!!
text: This is the second time we have done this activity with Sailing Trip Sitges. Last year we enjoyed the experience so much and they were so fun and so attentive that this year we took the opportunity to repeat since we were there to get away from Bilbao. We were able to bathe in the sea and left the board to reach the nearby cove. In addition we could shower in the port, which is to be appreciated as it is not possible anywhere. Thank you very much for the experience!
author: A-RMCG12

title: Am amazing day out with...
text: Am amazing day out with the family.   Lovely experience.  Oscar our skipper was friendly and very knowledgeable.   Remember to book your taxi to get there on time!!
author: Zara_H

title: We keep coming back for this one!
text: This was our second year to take this amazing sailing tour, and this excursion was just as great as the first time! Our skipper, Carlos, was truly accommodating and took time to point out the local sights. After a beautiful sail, we anchored for a bit near a local beach and got to spend time enjoying the water with a swim. It was so neat to experience the peace of sailing with the wind! Sandrine, our host, was helpful as always. Thank you!
author: johnbroady

title: Fabulous luxury experience
text: This boat trip was an exceptional event. The Boat exceeded all my expectations, beautiful, pristine large. The owner and the Skipper met us at the boat. It was easy to find, communication was good and we had the most amazing time. Huge thanks to our wonderful skipper Kai. This was an amazing and memorable day. I would highly recommend anyone to do this.

title: Highly recommend. Beautiful scenery, great perspective looking back at land
text: Clear water, calm waters. Beautiful views. Great to take a swim in the Sea. Carlos was an excellent host and captain. Was not aware that the captain charge was extra
